blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The Fire Walk smells of ash, resin, and ritualized courage, a path where heat is both danger and credential.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: Heat shimmers off the stones before you reach them. Travelers gather on the cool rocks to work up their nerve, then cross a path where vents breathe fire on their own timing. There is a strange local pride about doing it properly, and an unspoken scorn for...
